name: Halloumi Fries
steps: Cut halloumi into 1.5 cm thick batons and blot dry so they brown instead of steaming.
Mix flour and paprika. Roll each baton lightly in the mixture and shake away loose flour.
Heat half the oil in a wide skillet. Fry batons in batches for about 2 minutes per side until every face is golden and crisp; add the remaining oil as needed.
Drain briefly on a rack, scatter chopped parsley and serve immediately with lemon wedges while the centers are warm and springy.
tips: Halloumi is salty, so taste before adding any extra salt.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
